children: BlockBeats reported on August 29 that TradingBeats, formerly Hyperinsight, monitored James Wynn opening another 20x Bitcoin short position with a liquidation price of $80,483 and a current position value of $103,000. According to BlockBeats On-chain Detection, Wynn’s last known activity was in late July and early August, when he repeatedly shorted the S&P 500 and was liquidated multiple times.

title: James Wynn Opens a 20x Bitcoin Short Position With a Liquidation Price of $80,483
